title: [review] coap micro-hardening bundle: is_local_admin NULL-addr ZTEST default, missing-trust CBOR default, GET /keys OSCORE gap, rate-limit burn + iid7 bucket collapse, s_provider lock scope
description: P3 bundle from wave-1 security+robustness review: (1) coap_keys.c:53-56 lichen_coap_is_local_admin returns IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_ZTEST) for addr==NULL -> security predicate with config-dependent true default; return false unconditionally, adjust ztests to pass loopback addr. (2) coap_keys_cbor.c:302 decode_key_put_cbor defaults *trust=LICHEN_KEY_TRUST_VERIFIED when trust key absent -> fail-closed: reject or default lowest. (3) GET /keys + /keys/{iid} have no OSCORE handling even when CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=y -> inconsistent with PUT/DELETE; at minimum document, better mirror the unprotect+guard pattern. (4) coap_dtn.c:136,254 rate-limit window consumed even when store fails (availability polish) and iid7 single-byte key collapses non-IPv6/loopback peers into one bucket (cross-peer interference) -> key on full EUI64, burn only on accepted store. (5) coap_dtn.c:95/100-104 s_provider read outside mutex + addr NULL unchecked (framework guarantees non-NULL today) -> tighten.
